header.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.EQU_OP
header.description: Equipment Operational Data Domain Functional Block
header.author: Siemens.SimaticIT

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.CreateEquipment
command.description: Creates an instance of Equipment, starting from the specified Equipment Configuration. One instance can be created from each Equipment Configuration.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.DeleteEquipment
command.description: Deletes the Equipment Configuration indentified by the id passed as input, along with its Equipment instance, if one has been created.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.ForceEquipmentStatus
command.description: Sets the status of the Equipment, without checking the validity of the transition.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.SetEquipmentStatus
command.description: Sets the status of the Equipment, checking the validity of the transition.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateEquipment
command.description: Updates an existing Equipment instance. The Equipment is identified by the Equipment Configuration Id, starting from which it has been created.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateEquipmentProperty
command.description: Updates the value of an Equipment Property.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.FreezeEquipment
command.description: Configures the Equipment to be read-only by setting the **IsFrozen** attribute to True. The Equipment is identified by the Equipment Configuration Id, starting from which it has been created.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.UnfreezeEquipment
command.description: Removes the read-only setting from the Equipment by setting the **IsFrozen** attribute to False. The Equipment is identified by the Equipment Configuration Id, starting from which it has been created.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateEquipmentGroup
command.description: Synchronizes the Equipment Group with the Equipment Group Configuration.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateEquipmentGraphNode
command.description: Synchronizes the Equipment Graph Node with the Equipment Graph Node Configuration.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateEquipmentGraphLink
command.description: Synchronizes the Equipment Graph link with the Equipment Graph Link Configuration.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateEquipmentPropertyAttribute
command.description: Updates the value of an Equipment Property Attribute. The Equipment is identified by the Equipment Configuration Id, starting from which it has been created.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateEquipmentGraph
command.description: Synchronizes the Equipment Graph links and nodes with the Equipment Graph Configuration links and nodes.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.DeleteEquipmentStateMachine
command.description: Deletes the Equipment State Machine indentified by the id passed as input.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.CreateEquipmentStateMachines
command.description: Create a list of State Machine associated to the Equipment, taking the data from the source Equipment Configuration.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.SetEquipmentPropertyValue
command.description: Permits to modify an Equipment Property if its Operational value is set to true.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.SetEquipmentPropertyAttributeValue
command.description: Permits to modify an Equipment Property Attribute if its Operational value is set to true.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.FreezeEquipmentGroup
command.description: Configures the Equipment Group to be read-only by setting the attribute IsFrozen to True.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.UnfreezeEquipmentGroup
command.description: Removes the read-only setting from the Equipment Group by setting the attribute IsFrozen to False.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.DeleteEquipmentPropertyAttribute
command.description: Deletes an Equipment Property Attribute.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.SynchronizeEquipment
command.description: Synchronizes all Equipment Configurations with the runtime Equipment.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.SynchronizeEquipmentGroup
command.description: Synchronizes all Equipment Configuration Groups with the runtime Equipment Groups.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.OperationalData.EQU_OP.OPModel.Commands.SynchronizeEquipmentGraph
command.description: Synchronizes all Equipment Graph Configurations with the runtime Equipment Graphs. The type of Equipment Graph is specified by the input **Type** parameter, whose possible values are **Hierarchy** and **Flow**.
